gloss: to search for; to rummage; to hunt for

definitions.gloss: to search for; to rummage through
definitions.explanation: To search through things looking for something specific, often in a messy or thorough way.
When animals or people search for food.

examples.japanese: ネットで{情報|じょうほう}を{漁|あさ}る。
examples.english: To search the internet for information.

examples.japanese: {引|ひ}き{出|だ}しの{中|なか}を{漁|あさ}った。
{古本屋|ふるほんや}で{珍|めずら}しい{本|ほん}を{漁|あさ}った。
examples.english: I rummaged through the used bookstore looking for rare books.

examples.japanese: {冷蔵庫|れいぞうこ}の{中|なか}を{漁|あさ}って{食|た}べるものを{探|さが}した。
examples.english: I rummaged through the fridge looking for something to eat.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{毎晩|まいばん}ネットで{安|やす}い{航空券|こうくうけん}を{漁|あさ}っているが、なかなか{見|み}つからないらしい。
examples.english: He searches the internet for cheap plane tickets every night, but apparently can't find any.

examples.japanese: {鳥|とり}が{餌|えさ}を{漁|あさ}る。
{熊|くま}が{ゴミ箱|ごみばこ}を{漁|あさ}っていた。
examples.english: A bear was rummaging through the garbage.

examples.japanese: {野良猫|のらねこ}がゴミ{袋|ぶくろ}を{漁|あさ}っている。
examples.english: A stray cat is scavenging through the garbage bags.

examples.japanese: {秋|あき}になると{栗鼠|りす}は{木|き}の{実|み}を{漁|あさ}って{冬|ふゆ}に{備|そな}える。
examples.english: In autumn, squirrels forage for nuts in preparation for winter.

examples.japanese: {干潮|かんちょう}の{時|とき}に{浜辺|はまべ}で{貝|かい}を{漁|あさ}るのが{子供|こども}の{頃|ころ}の{楽|たの}しみだった。
examples.english: Foraging for shellfish on the beach at low tide was one of the joys of my childhood.

notes:
{漁|あさ}る is a transitive verb ({他動詞|たどうし}). There is no intransitive pair.

ASPECT ({ている}):
{漁|あさ}っている indicates an ongoing action of searching or rummaging.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- [place]を{漁|あさ}る - to rummage through [place]
- {情報|じょうほう}を{漁|あさ}る - to hunt for information
- {餌|えさ}を{漁|あさ}る - to forage for food
- {女|おんな}/{男|おとこ}を{漁|あさ}る - to pursue women/men (negative nuance)

NUANCE:
This verb often implies a somewhat indiscriminate or thorough search, sometimes with a slightly negative connotation of being greedy or indiscriminate.

KANJI NOTE:
The kanji {漁|あさ} is the same as in {漁業|ぎょぎょう} (fishing industry), reflecting the original meaning of fishing/foraging.
